title: Contract
description: The signed agreement resulting from an award, and what was actually paid under it. Mirrors the OCDS contract and implementation blocks. Keeping the contract value distinct from the award value, and both distinct from amounts actually transacted, is what lets an auditor see overruns.

contractId.description: The buyer's own reference for this contract.

awardId.description: The Award this contract implements. Must match an awardId in the same contracting process; the validator checks it.

title.description: A short label for the contract.

description.description: A plain-language summary of what the contract covers.

value.description: The `Amount` the contract is signed for.

amountPaid.description: Total transacted to date under this contract.

document.description: Links to supporting documents, e.g. the signed contract itself.
